correctness.rationale: Bijective sum-and-difference parametrization gives (t-w)(t+w)(t²+w²+6s²+4c)=0 modulo p². Unit c makes the quadratic component smooth modulo p. Exactly one vanishing factor lifts in p² ways, at least two in p³ ways. Explicit Legendre sums yield U and I, and p²U+(p³-p²)I reproduces the boxed formula. Direct exact pair-convolution over five distinct prime-square moduli verifies 20 unit-perturbation cases; separate geometry checks verify conic and intersection formulas at nine primes. A finite check is not treated as proof. The mod-four difference is an exact algebraic consequence.

value.rationale: The parameter family (x,x⁴+cx²) is the first natural even quadratic deformation of the quartic Fourier graph over the first nonfield ring. The exact fourth Fourier moment is a natural restriction-theoretic invariant. The result holds for all unit c and all primes ≥5, resolves singular-versus-transverse lift contributions geometrically, shows invariance under c→c+pk and exhibits a sharp reversal of residue-class energy ordering with p modulo four. Its structural parameter split is not an arbitrary finite slice or a routine numerical increment.
